title: 第7章 两妃子争风吃醋第8章 驱狼吞虎借刀杀人
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
lines: 远处。
夜弦月听到秦然的话后神色剧震。
龙运居然提前凝聚了？
她身影一闪，瞬息间出现在秦然与唐梦宫身侧。
不由分说，她抬手一把攥住了唐梦宫的手腕，阻止了其抽取龙运的动作。
“陛下，梦妃，你们这是在干嘛呢，手攥得这么紧，不累吗？”夜弦月笑眯眯道。
唐梦宫转过头，目光蓦然冰冷。
“夜弦月，今日你不该来这里。”
她的意思不言而喻，按照九个妃子之间的约定，今天的云江仙属于她唐梦宫。
夜弦月不慌不忙，笑盈盈的看向唐梦宫。
“梦妃，是陛下约我来这里一起用早膳的，陛下的旨意怎能忤逆呢？”
唐梦宫没有好脸色，私底下开始传音。
“魔女！你要破坏规矩，阻拦本小姐抽取龙运？”
“非也！我们定的规矩是，在不影响云江仙凝聚龙运的情况下，各凭手段抽取逸散龙运，他如今处于快速凝聚龙运的阶段，妹妹也不想时间拖延太久，出现其它竞争者吧？”
“聒噪！规矩可以明日再改，但今日他的龙运，本小姐非要不可！”
“咯咯，今日我在这里，妹妹怕是不能如愿了呢～”
“夜弦月，你确定？”
听着夜弦月的话，唐梦宫又想到了刚才脑海中看到的画面，心中莫名涌起烦躁。
不过此刻争胜阶段，自然不肯落下风。
她对秦然这些年来的舔狗情，还是有些自信的。
“夜弦月，你清楚本小姐与云江仙之间的关系，你觉得云江仙会站在你那边，还是站在我这边呢？”
唐梦宫自信传音，“本小姐只需一句话，他就会让你离开，你相信吗？”
夜弦月安静了。
云江仙对唐梦宫的态度人尽皆知，这一点她无可辩驳。
即便剩余几个妃子加在一起，恐怕也抵不上唐梦宫一个人的宠爱。
她的实力可以碾压年轻的唐梦宫，但在云江仙面前，她却根本没有办法公然出手……
唐梦宫多了几分得意。
“这龙运，本小姐要定了！谁来也阻止不了！！”
两个女人四目相对，没有出声，但私底下却已剑拔弩张。
打起来！
打起来！！
秦然察言观色，心中加油，面上却接着装傻。
他的妃子团，每天打逸散龙运的主意也是个麻烦事，他要借快速凝聚龙运为由，把这麻烦事从根本上解决。
他巴不得这九个妃子闹得越凶越好……
content_en:
far away.
Ye Xianyue's expression was shocked after hearing Qin Ran's words.
Dragon luck actually gathered in advance?
Her figure flashed and appeared beside Qin Ran and Tang Mengong in an instant.
Without any explanation, she raised her hand and grabbed Tang Menggong's wrist, stopping him from extracting Long Yun.
"Your Majesty, Concubine Meng, what are you doing? Aren't you tired with your hands clenched so tightly?" Ye Xianyue said with a smile.
Tang Menggong turned his head, his eyes suddenly turned cold.
"Yexianyue, you shouldn't be here today."
Her meaning is self-evident. According to the agreement between the nine concubines, today's Yunjiang Immortal belongs to her, Tang Meng Palace.
Ye Xianyue was calm and looked at Tang Meng Palace with a smile.
"Concubine Meng, Your Majesty invited me to come here to have breakfast together. How can I disobey His Majesty's will?"
Tang Menggong didn't have a good face and started transmitting messages in private.
"Witch! Are you going to break the rules and prevent me from drawing dragon luck?"
"No! The rule we have set is that without affecting Yunjiang Immortal's ability to condense dragon luck, each of us can use our own means to extract the escaped dragon luck. He is now in the stage of rapidly condensing dragon luck. My sister doesn't want time to delay too long and other competitors appear, right?"
"Noisy! The rules can be changed tomorrow, but today, I must ensure his dragon luck!"
"Gee, I'm here today. I'm afraid my sister won't be able to get her wish~"
"Yexianyue, are you sure?"
"Of course~~"
Listening to Ye Xianyue's words, Tang Menggong thought of the scene he just saw in his mind again, and felt inexplicably irritated in his heart.
But at this stage of winning, he naturally refused to lose.
She was still somewhat confident in Kieran's love affair with him over the years.
"Ye Xianyue, you know the relationship between me and Yunjiangxian. Do you think Yunjiangxian will stand on your side or mine?"
Tang Menggong confidently said, "As long as I say a word, he will let you leave. Do you believe it?"
The night crescent moon is quiet.
Everyone knows Yun Jiangxian's attitude towards Tang Meng Palace, and she cannot argue with this.
Even if the remaining concubines were put together, they might not be able to match the favor of Tang Meng Palace alone.
Her strength can crush the young Tang Mengong, but in front of Yun Jiangxian, she has no way to take action openly...
Tang Menggong was a little more proud.
"This young lady will decide the fate of this dragon! No one can stop it!!"
The two women looked at each other without saying a word, but secretly they were already tense.
Fight!
Fight! !
Qin Ran observed his words and cheered up in his heart, but continued to act stupid on his face.
It is also a troublesome thing for his group of concubines to try to escape the dragon's luck every day. He wants to fundamentally solve this trouble on the pretext of quickly condensing the dragon's luck.
He wished that these nine concubines would make more trouble, the better...
